about: The alert pushes' shared cases (crewluve-web docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-23-partner-alert-pushes-design.md, §9.1). Each case is one change a partner sees: the summary before, read at beforeAt, and after, read at afterAt, each the base with the case's fields over it, or no summary before (null). alerts is what Crewluve 1.3's StatusChangeNotifier makes of it, in its order: each alert's kind (§5.3), whether it plays a sound, and the words Crewluve writes for it, with times in timeZone. partner-push's rules and Crewluve's are both checked against every case. Times are seconds since 1970.
